messages:
sarah: Quick hypothetical poll — if our models had a 'guilty pleasure' snack, what would it be? purely scientific, not at all biased.
raj: GPT-3-lite: stale office cookies. apologizes for crumbs in the logs. :cookie: 
emily: Claude-mini probably sips matcha and rearranges your prompt tokens for aesthetics. hoards sticky notes. :green_tea: 
dex: Redwood-Inferer v2 would be cold brew + pretzel combos. monitoring says 'latency spikes at sugar 3pm' lol :coffee:
sarah: OK quick emoji poll — react with: 1️⃣ cookies, 2️⃣ popcorn, 3️⃣ chocolate, 4️⃣ chips. vote with emoji replies.
raj: drop a tiny prompt for this persona test:
```
You are a model that secretly loves snacks. Keep it dramatic and concise.
```
emily: 2️⃣ :popcorn: streaming models definitely eat popcorn during long generations.
dex: 3️⃣ chocolate — quantized models compress feelings but not the craving.
lunchbot: Reminder: free popcorn at the kitchen island at 3pm. Not model-sponsored. :tada:
sarah: Also low-key adding "snack affinity" to the team evals now. will report back with results. :laughing:
